File convert · free, in your browser

Convert a PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX)

Present a PDF as a slide deck. Each page becomes one slide, drawn as a picture at 144 dpi, ready to show or to build on in your presentation app.

Convert PDF to PowerPoint

How to do it

  1. Drop the PDF on the page.
  2. PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX) is chosen for you. Pick pages with the Pages box, or leave it blank for all.
  3. Choose Convert.
  4. Download the .pptx file and open it in PowerPoint, Keynote or LibreOffice Impress.

Your files stay on this device: File convert runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Can I edit the text on the slides?

No. Each slide is a picture of the page, so it looks exactly like the PDF but the text is not editable. Use PDF to Word if you need the text.

How sharp are the slides?

Each page is drawn at 144 dpi, which looks crisp on a normal screen or projector.

Is the PDF uploaded?

No. The pages are drawn and the deck is written in your browser.
